description: Daily Swiss energy-supply data from the Federal Office of Energy's energy dashboard: 'electricity_production' (Electricity production by energy source (Swissgrid), GWh/day); 'electricity_consumption' (National and final electricity consumption (Swissgrid), GWh/day); 'electricity_consumption_estimate' (Model-based estimate of national electricity consumption (recent days), GWh/day); 'electricity_consumption_forecast' (Electricity final-consumption forecast min/mean/max (SDSC), GWh/day); 'electricity_cross_border' (Cross-border electricity flows per neighbour and net import, GWh/day); 'electricity_spot_price' (Day-ahead spot price Switzerland, baseload, EUR/MWh); 'gas_cross_border' (Cross-border gas flows per neighbour and net import, GWh/day); 'gas_net_imports_monthly' (Monthly gas net imports (VSG), GWh/month); 'gas_storage_eu' (Gas storage levels EU and neighbouring countries, TWh / % of capacity). Returns the last `last_days` (default 30) or a date range, optionally aggregated by week/month/year (energy summed, prices/levels averaged) and filtered to one category (production: 'Kernkraft', 'Flusskraft', 'Speicherkraft', 'Photovoltaik', 'Wind', 'Thermische'; gas storage: 'EU', 'Germany', 'Italy', …). Example: {series: 'electricity_production', aggregate: 'month', from: '2025-01-01'}.

aggregate.description: Aggregate to weeks, months or years

category.description: Only this category (energy source or storage region)

from.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD (or YYYY-MM for monthly series)

last_days.description: Without `from`: how many most recent dates to return

name: get_energy_dashboard
title: Swiss energy supply indicators (energiedashboard.ch)
